claims: Bracketing methods (bisect/brentq) and iterative root solvers
Sensitivity of a root to perturbations of f; stopping criteria

checks: Fixed-point x=cos(x) from x0=0.5: 68 iterations; |g'(x*)| = sin(x*) ~ 0.674
Iteration bound n >= log2((b-a)/eps): for [0,1], eps=1e-12 -> ~40 steps
Cobweb: g=cos x (|g'|~0.674) converges; g=1.5x-0.25 (|g'|=1.5) diverges
